# aihu framework

aihu is a JavaScript/TypeScript meta-framework for building Web Components with runtime-first reactivity. Authors write Single-File Components (SFCs) in `.aihu` files composed of `@state`, `@template`, `@style`, `@route`, and `@agent` blocks. The compiler lowers each SFC to a vanilla custom element — no framework import lands at the consumer boundary, no hydration step, no global context.

The reactive core (`@aihu/signals`) uses a doubly-linked dependency graph with push-based propagation; `@aihu/arbor` materialises the compiled VDOM into real DOM nodes using `nodeValue` bindings (not `textContent`) for 122× faster targeted text updates.

## Right idioms

### 1. Declare signals with the tuple destructure; mutate only via the setter

```ts
// Inside @state { ... }
import { signal } from '@aihu/signals'
const [count, setCount] = signal(0)

// Correct mutation — call the setter
setCount(count() + 1)
setCount(prev => prev + 1)   // updater form also accepted
```

Read a signal inside `@template` by referencing its name without parentheses:
```html
<h1>Count: {count}</h1>
```
The compiler knows `count` is a `Read<number>` and generates a live binding automatically.

### 2. Use v2 collection-form macros in `@state`

All macros use the object-literal collection form (v2). `$prop`, `$computed`, `$action`, `$effect`, and `$lifecycle` are keyed blocks:

```ts
@state {
  import { signal } from '@aihu/signals'
  const [name, setName] = signal('world')

  $prop: {
    greeting: { type: string, default: 'Hello', describe: 'Greeting prefix' },
  }

  $computed: {
    message: () => `${greeting} ${name()}`,
  }

  $action: {
    reset: {
      describe: 'Reset name to world',
      expose: { read: true, write: true },
      handler: () => setName('world'),
    },
  }

  $lifecycle: {
    mount: () => { console.log('mounted') },
  }

  $effect: () => {
    document.title = message()
  }
}
```

### 3. Template macro attributes use colon-form for bindings, dot-form does not exist in templates

In `@template`, directive attributes use `$on:event`, `$bind:value`, `$if`, `$each`, `$key`:

```html
@template {
  <ul>
    <li $each="items as item" $key={item.id}>
      <input $bind:value="item.name" $on:input={() => save(item)} />
      <button $on:click={() => remove(item.id)}>x</button>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <p $if={items.length === 0}>No items yet.</p>
}
```

### 4. Router primitives come from `@aihu/router`; use `$route` in state

```ts
@state {
  import { useRoute } from '@aihu/router'
  import { computed } from '@aihu/signals'

  const currentRoute = computed(() => useRoute())
  // $route macro is also available in @template for SSR-safe access
}

@route {
  path: "/posts/:slug",
  name: "post-detail",
  ssr: true
}
```

Navigation guards registered at the component level:
```ts
$beforeNavigate((to, from, next) => {
  if (unsaved()) return next(false)
  next()
})
```

### 5. Expose agent surface from `@state`, not from `@agent`

The v2 `@agent` block only holds `$scope` and `$rate-limit`. Expose and describe go inside the `$prop`, `$computed`, and `$action` collection entries:

```ts
$action: {
  addItem: {
    describe: 'Add a new item to the list',
    expose: { read: true, write: true },
    handler: (text: string) => setItems([...items(), { id: crypto.randomUUID(), text }]),
  },
}
```

## Anti-patterns

### 1. Never reassign a signal directly or via `$prop`

```ts
// WRONG — signals are read-only; direct assignment is a no-op or type error
count = 5
$prop.name = 'Alice'

// CORRECT
setCount(5)
setName('Alice')
```

Signals returned by `signal()` are `readonly [Read<T>, Write<T>]` tuples. The `Read<T>` function has no setter; mutation always goes through `Write<T>`.

### 2. Do not use v1 colon-form macros in `@state`

v1 syntax used statement-level `$action name(...) { }`, `$computed name = expr`, and `$lifecycle.mount(() => { })`. All of these are v2-migrated to collection form. Running the codemod (`npx aihu migrate`) upgrades automatically.

```ts
// WRONG — v1 statement form
$action addTodo() { todos = [...todos(), { text: draft() }] }
$computed remaining = todos().filter(t => !t.done).length
$lifecycle.mount(() => { load() })

// CORRECT — v2 collection form
$action: {
  addTodo: () => { setTodos([...todos(), { text: draft() }]) },
}
$computed: {
  remaining: () => todos().filter(t => !t.done).length,
}
$lifecycle: {
  mount: () => { load() },
}
```

### 3. Never import from `@scribe/*` — the package scope is `@aihu/*`

The framework was renamed. All packages live under `@aihu/`:

```ts
// WRONG
import { signal } from '@scribe/signals'
import { mount } from '@scribe/arbor'

// CORRECT
import { signal } from '@aihu/signals'
import { branch, leaf, mount } from '@aihu/arbor'
```

### 4. Do not use `textContent` for reactive text nodes — the runtime uses `nodeValue`

When writing low-level arbor code or debugging DOM bindings, `nodeValue` is the reactive property, not `textContent`. Suggesting `textContent` for a reactive text leaf will bypass the signal subscription.

```ts
// WRONG — bypasses the reactive binding
node.textContent = count().toString()

// CORRECT — arbor manages this automatically via nodeValue on Text nodes
leaf(count)  // pass the Signal<string> to leaf(); arbor wires nodeValue
```

### 5. Do not wrap `@route` path params as optional unless the route is truly optional

`@route` path segments like `:slug` are required by default. Making them optional (`/:slug?`) changes router matching behavior and is rarely correct for leaf routes:

```ts
// WRONG for a leaf route — slug will be undefined when not provided
@route { path: "/posts/:slug?" }

// CORRECT — required param
@route { path: "/posts/:slug" }
```

## Canonical example files

- `examples/live-counter/live-counter.aihu` — minimal signal + action SFC (7GUIs #1)
- `examples/todo-mvc/todo-mvc.aihu` — full CRUD: signals, computed, lifecycle, effects, agent surface
- `examples/_shared/macro-test.aihu` — v2 collection-form macro reference with all macro types
- `packages/compiler/tests/codemods/fixtures/todo-mvc.input.aihu` — v1 syntax (before migration)
- `packages/compiler/tests/codemods/fixtures/todo-mvc.expected.aihu` — v2 syntax (after migration)
- `packages/router/components/Link.aihu` — router integration, `$prop`, `$action`, `$lifecycle`
- `examples/blog-router/src/pages/index.aihu` — `@route` + `$each` list rendering
- `examples/hacker-news/src/pages/index.aihu` — SSR route with loader data, `$each`, `$if`
